title: Concept: Git HEAD file served from the web root
description: The contents of a git HEAD reference file in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A readable HEAD proves the whole .git directory is published, which means object files, history, stashes and any credential ever committed are reachable from the same host.
applicability: Deployments that render the contents of a git HEAD reference file into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A readable HEAD proves the whole .git directory is published, which means object files, history, stashes and any credential ever committed are reachable from the same host.
